svg.title: Two routes lead to the same place: an image version in a gallery
svg.desc: Route 1: build a virtual machine by hand, then run Sysprep to generalize it and capture it into an Azure Compute Gallery. Route 2: describe the image with a source image and customizations, and Azure Image Builder builds it and distributes it. Both routes end as an image version in the gallery, which replicates it to target regions. Session hosts in a host pool are created from a version in their region. The AVD agent registered to a host pool and a domain join must stay out of the image.
svg.text: Two routes lead to the same place: an image version in a gallery
Route 1: build by hand and capture
Route 2: describe the image, the service builds it
session hosts are created from a version in their region
Must stay out of the image
The AVD agent registered to a host pool (its registration token expires)
A domain join (remove the machine from the domain before Sysprep)
